title: The 15-Minute Weekly Numbers Review: 4 weekly reviews I'd pick again
caption:
4 weekly reviews I'd pick again

This is what worked. Steal the system:
1️⃣ Choose 3 numbers — Leads, close rate, revenue. Ignore vanity metrics.
2️⃣ Same time every week — Friday 4pm. Non-negotiable. Consistency beats intensity.
3️⃣ Look at the trend, not the day — One week means nothing. 4-week direction tells the truth.
4️⃣ One change per week — Pick the weakest number. One experiment to move it. Repeat.

Try it and tell me what happens.
